description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - a gaze-coverage cleaning check: six easy-to-miss zones (window side, doorway, bedside, cabinet top, wall corner, under desk) are bound to head headings in SETUP; in SWEEP you turn slowly and a zone is covered only after your gaze dwells on it steadily for 2 seconds (or is honestly marked by tap), with missed-zone turn guidance until every corner has been looked at
name: clean-check
